cards.name: Eclipse Observatory

coverage_override.reason: The always-treated identity condition is audited independently from the optional activation search/draw and the opponent-Special-Summon trigger; each activation/HOPT restriction is included with its governed effect.

effects.printed_clause: (This card is always treated as an "Eclipse Observer" card.)
effects.lua_implementation: The behavior is data-driven rather than registered as an Effect: CCG_v1.db stores setcode bytes f4 f2 17 eb for this card, giving it both Eclipse (0xf2f4) and Eclipse Observer (0xeb17) membership. The Lua also publishes both values in listed_series.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Omega likewise represents an always-treated identity in card database metadata while the operational script contains the card's usable effects; no runtime identity-changing effect registration is required.

effects.printed_clause: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Eclipse Observer" monster and 1 "Eclipse" Quick-Play Spell from your Deck to your hand, and if you do, your opponent draws 2 cards. You can only activate 1 "Eclipse Observatory" per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The optional activation search now recognizes custom Eclipse Quick-Play Spells plus Book of Eclipse and Book of Lunar Eclipse. Both official IDs are included in AddCodeList/listed_names, and a successful two-card add still precedes the opponent's two-card draw.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Omega performs a simultaneous two-card Deck search with separate card qualifications, requires both selections, sends the merged group to hand, and confirms it.
The official Omega DB and script identify Book of Lunar Eclipse as an Eclipse-named Quick-Play Spell omitted by the CCG's manually enumerated official-name pool.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: Book of Lunar Eclipse (31834488) was omitted from the activation search pool.

effects.printed_clause: If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can target 1 of those monsters; negate its effects, and if you do, banish that monster, then your opponent draws 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Eclipse Observatory" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The delayed EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS trigger filters the event group with Card.IsSummonPlayer(1-tp), following official Shining Sarcophagus provenance handling. It can target a legal face-up monster the opponent actually Special Summoned regardless of its post-summon controller, then negates, banishes, and performs the dependent draw.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Omega handles 'your opponent Special Summons' by testing Card.IsSummonPlayer(1-tp) on the event group, then limits the target to one of those qualifying summoned monsters.
Official Omega reacts to an opponent's Special Summon, targets one of the event monsters, and negates that monster's effects with a delayed summon-success trigger.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the prior filter used post-summon control instead of the player who performed the Special Summon.

cards.audit_note: Added Book of Lunar Eclipse to Observatory and corrected opponent Special Summon provenance.
